pages.text: $(bold)Authentic Mutual Love$(): when truth wears the mask of falsehood, every art bends to my will.$(br2)$(bold)Expansion$(): press the domain expansion key to unfold the domain around yourself - it seals its occupants in like any other domain, draining radius x25 curse power per second. The instant it expands, the caster enters the $(bold)Borrowed Technique$() state.

$(bold)Borrowed Technique$(): while the domain lasts, the technique switch key cycles through $(bold)every technique you have unlocked in the Patchouli guide in this save$() - no longer bound to the single technique on your current core; any unlocked technique (Yu Chu Zi, Blood Manipulation, Ten Shadows, Cursed Speech, Construct, and so on) can be switched to and unleashed on the spot.$(br2)$(bold)Only while the domain is active$(): when it closes (manually, out of curse power, or destroyed) or you leave it, the technique selected before the expansion is restored automatically.$(br2)$(bold)What counts as unlocked$(): wearing a core that carries a technique's trait automatically unlocks that technique's chapter in the guide.
